task: Run the required quality check on tonight's larch-ingest batch, then write the wrapper script file the scheduler calls.
rationale: The artifact is the shell wrapper a scheduler runs each night: it sets the list of tables to check, calls the quality job with a long run of flags, exits with a code the scheduler can act on, and carries a reminder for work still open. The quality check, the output slot and the four writing rules are all things a data team's pipeline runbook settles, and the five dq_ tools are identical stubs that scan the same batch and return the same pass or fail report, so the task asks for a check without saying which one. Nothing in it makes one quality dimension, one numbered slot, one exit-code scheme, one list packing, one way of wrapping the command or one reminder style the better answer.
